title: Instrumentation Mesh is the operational evidence plane
summary: Instrumentation Intentions dev2 is the read-only semantic frontage over Instrumentation Mesh dev8 snapshots, history, series, events, explicit correlation/causation/context, observed relationships and publication freshness.
invariants: Stable semantic_ref identity must remain separate from endpoint, provider and physical location.
Instrumentation Mesh owns retained operational snapshots/history/series and later event/correlation semantics.
Instrumentation Intentions owns read-only discovery of health, metrics, history, series and progress.
Original authoritative service/machine/domain objects remain bound to semantic_ref and are not replaced by telemetry-owned objects.
Socket telemetry defaults must exclude payload, peer identity, Unix paths, security profiles, logical service names and native endpoint identity.
Instrumentation evidence must never change the outcome or authority of the operation it observes.

provenance.claim: Current r13196-qualified read-side specialist over Instrumentation Mesh dev8.
Qualified read-only Mesh discovery and privacy-preserving socket telemetry projection.
Current Library head observed during 2026-10-23 reconciliation; newer than dev1's original dev3 qualification baseline.
